answer.says: No, thank you, Ramesh. I have just finished a passage on the self-presence of the Idea, and my mind is full; I would rather have the silence of the room to let it settle. You may keep the samosas for yourself.
answer.thought: The afternoon light is sharp, cutting through the haze that keeps me indoors. I have written enough for the morning; the next step requires a change of scene, even if it is only from the study to the verandah, to let the thoughts on the state and India breathe a little before I attempt to walk them out.
